caption: The drawing depicts a handkerchief positioned at the center of a blank, off-white background. The handkerchief is a light gray or off-white color with elaborate blue lace embroidery along the edges, featuring floral and paisley patterns. A section of the upper part of the handkerchief is folded back, exposing the underside and a small inset area of beige embroidery with a more detailed lace pattern, as well as a blue border. In the middle right of the main handkerchief, there is a blue, octagonal stamp containing text in French. The overall composition is presented in a realistic style, with the texture and folds of the fabric carefully rendered. The artist’s signature is visible in the lower left-hand corner.
title: Embroidered Handkerchief
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
